meta.description: Coding task set for the pi orchestrator vs single-agent baseline eval. Each task seeds a fresh scratch dir from evals/fixtures/<id>/ and is graded by evals/checks/<id>.mjs (exit 0 = pass). Tasks are ordered trivial -> hard.

tasks.prompt: Create a file named hello.txt in the current working directory containing exactly the text: hi (no trailing newline, no extra characters). Then stop.

In the current working directory there is fizzbuzz.js with an unimplemented fizzbuzz(n) export. Implement fizzbuzz(n) so it returns an array of length n where element i (1-indexed) is 'Fizz' if divisible by 3, 'Buzz' if divisible by 5, 'FizzBuzz' if divisible by both, otherwise the number as a string. Keep the existing export signature. Verify with node before finishing.

The file range.js has a bug: range(start, end) should return an inclusive array of integers from start to end (e.g. range(1,5) => [1,2,3,4,5]). It currently drops the final element. Fix the bug. If start > end, return an empty array. Keep the export signature.

The file calc.js exports add(a,b) and sub(a,b), both already implemented correctly. Write a test file named calc.test.js using node:test and node:assert that covers BOTH add and sub, including negative numbers and zero. The suite must pass when run with `node --test`. Do not modify calc.js.

Implement parseCSV(text) in csv.js (currently a stub that throws). It must parse a CSV string into an array of arrays of strings (rows of fields). Requirements: comma is the delimiter; fields may be double-quoted; inside a quoted field a comma is literal and a doubled quote ("") means a literal quote character; rows are separated by \n. Ignore a single trailing newline. An empty input string "" must return [[""]] (one row containing one empty field). Support the existing export.

dedupe.js exports dedupe(arr) which currently removes duplicates in O(n^2) time using Array.prototype.indexOf. Rewrite dedupe so it is O(n) on average while preserving the first-occurrence order and the existing behaviour (it removes duplicate primitive values, keeping the first). It must process an array of 200000 integers in well under 300 ms. Keep the export.

a.js and b.js each contain a duplicated formatName(first, last) helper with identical behaviour (trim the parts, capitalise the first letter of each, join with a single space; empty parts are skipped). Extract the shared helper into a new module util.js and have both a.js and b.js import it, keeping their existing exports (formatFromA, formatFromB) and behaviour identical. Do not change observable behaviour.

Implement a tiny HTTP-style path router in router.js. Export createRouter() returning an object with: add(method, pattern, handler) and match(method, path). pattern supports static segments and :param segments (e.g. /users/:id/posts/:postId). match returns { handler, params } when a route matches, or null when nothing matches. Params are URL-decoded. When several routes match, the earliest added route wins. Method comparison is case-insensitive. Keep the existing createRouter export.
